Gemini and Libra compatibility

How Gemini (Mithun) and Libra (Tula) are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Air (both)
Modes
Mutable (dwiswabhava) and Cardinal (chara)
Ruling planets
Mercury and Venus
Place in the zodiac
5/9 from each other
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
5 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
0 of 7 points (dosha, cancelled)
Sign-level view
Mixed — Bhakoot dosha traditionally cancelled

Gemini horoscope · Libra horoscope

The elements: both Air

Gemini and Libra are both Air signs. Signs of one element are traditionally the easiest companions: they want the same kind of life and react to things in similar ways, while being different enough signs to keep things interesting.

Temperament

Libra is a cardinal sign that likes to lead, Gemini a mutable sign that adapts. That usually makes decisions easy, and the tradition's caution is only that Gemini's flexibility should not turn into always giving way.

The ruling planets

Gemini is ruled by Mercury and Libra by Venus. In the natural friendship of the planets, Mercury counts Venus as a friend, and Venus counts Mercury as a friend. That gives this pair 5 of 5 points in Graha Maitri. Each planet counts the other a friend, the warmest combination there is.

Their place in the zodiac

Counted from Gemini, Libra is the fifth sign; counted from Libra, Gemini is the ninth. In Bhakoot this is a 5/9 placement. That is a Bhakoot dosha and scores 0 of 7, but the classical texts treat it as cancelled when the two signs share a lord or their lords are friends, as they are here.

What each brings

Gemini is traditionally said to bring conversation, curiosity, wit and a light touch to a relationship, and to need variety, ideas to share and the freedom to stay curious. Libra is said to bring fairness, charm and a real wish for partnership, and to need harmony, balance and decisions that are made together. The pair does well when each gives what the other needs, rather than what they would want themselves.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Gemini and Libra compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: mixed — Bhakoot dosha traditionally cancelled. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 5 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 0 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Does it matter which partner is Gemini and which is Libra?

Not for anything on this page: elements, temperament, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot read the same both ways. Some other kootas of Guna Milan, such as Varna and Vashya, do look at who is the bride and who is the groom.
